conditions.text: src/clamp.mjs implements the specified named export, and tests/clamp.accept.test.mjs remains unchanged.
tests/clamp.test.mjs covers the clamp behavior and reversed-bound RangeError.

stages.task: Add a named clamp export in src/clamp.mjs that limits x to [lo, hi] and throws RangeError when lo > hi. Add tests/clamp.test.mjs with unit tests for values inside, below, and above the range, equal bounds, and reversed bounds. Leave tests/clamp.accept.test.mjs unchanged and all changes uncommitted.
stages.title: Implement and test clamp
